verdict: 0x42FC20 is the bag-list record-place core with signature (ecx=bag, stack: flag:dword, slot:dword, itemRecord[0xC20] by value), ret 0xC28. Its 13 direct E8 callers are fully named: 10 server-msg sites covering 9 inbound message IDs (0x35, 0xC8, 0x259, 0x268, 0x27C, 0x2A2 with TWO fills, 0x2A4, 0x2A5, 0x2A9), each pushing the 0xC20 record by value and filling the player bag at game+0x2AB9E0; plus 3 non-handler callers (login/reset dump 0x42E0C1 into obj+0x6554, bag-class slot re-place 0x42FD97, slot update 0x42FF30). Records land in the slot-record array at [bag+0x774 + i*0xC2C] (flag at slot base, width/height at +0x778/+0x77C, 0xC20 record body at +0x780) with the grid WORD cell table at [bag+0x324 + 12*row + 2*col] (6 cols, empty=0xFFFF, slot id words, slot+0x3E8 marker on the first cell) — the pending text's 'this+0x2C4' is corrected to bag+0x324. The trade window +0x298 item-id words are NOT written by any 0x42FC20 path: they are populated by the separate trade-class chain inbound 0x2A3/0x2A6/0x2AA -> 0x4161F0 -> 0x416490 (init 0xFFFF at ctor 0x415650/0x4158B3), and msgs 0x402/0x403/0x405/0x406 are outbound-only senders (0x451AA0/0x451AD0/0x451B00/0x451B30 -> 0x452940 + 0x451E60) — their pairing with inbound replies remains runtime/packet scope. Msg 0x2A3 is NOT a bag fill (trade pending flush 0x416E20); msg 0x29E shows the trade-gold dialog (0x418030, format 0x47B70C) and resets the bag's +0x2375C stats block (0x42FF90).

conclusions.claim: 0x42FC20 signature and structure: SEH prologue (fs:[0] frame, 0x475168), this=ecx=bag; stack args at entry: 0xC20-byte item record [entry+0], slot:dword [entry+0xC20], flag:dword [entry+0xC24]; ret 0xC28 (pops record+2 dwords). A caller-local dword above the flag ([callee esp+0xC48], observed set to 4 in the msg 0xC8 path as the item-copy flag at handler [esp+0x3F88] [INFERENCE linkage]) gates position parsing: nonzero -> 0x42F2A0(bag, flag, buf2, buf1) record parse then 0x42F280 free-slot scan; zero -> 0x42F280 directly; both paths then call 0x42F440(bag, buf, slot) and SEH-epilogue via 0x403AC0. Caller push sequences verified at 0x42FF30 (push 1; push slot; sub esp,0xC20; rep movsd 0x308) and 0x41EE34/0x41EE9F (push 0; push 0; same copy).

0x42F280 = first-free-slot scan: iterates 46 slots (0x2E) from bag+0x774, stride 0xC2C, returning the first index whose slot-flag dword is 0, or -1 if full. 0x42F2A0 = record position parse: reads the grid-rect struct field [buf2+0x28] (frame id), calls 0x42F6D0 (frame dims) and the fn-ptr [0x4762B0], computes the target rect, and validates candidate cells are free (word [bag+cell] == -1) with bounds 0x162..0xF72 bytes (0x42F3B9/0x42F3DF); returns 1/0.

0x42F440 = record place (single E8 caller 0x42FC90, confirming EI-262): (a) writes the grid WORD cell table - slot-id word per cell at [bag + 2*(6*row + 0x162 + col)] = [bag + 0x324 + 12*row + 2*col] (row pitch 12B, col pitch 2B, 6 cols; empty cells stay 0xFFFF/-1); (b) the FIRST cell of the item additionally receives slot+0x3E8 (0x42F496 lea ebp,[ebx+0x3E8]; 0x42F64C add esi,0x3E8); (c) sets slot record flag=1 at [bag+0x774+i*0xC2C], width at +0x778, height at +0x77C (from the grid rect), then copies the 0xC20 record from the passed buffer to [slot+0x780] (rep movsd 0x308 dwords, 0x42F6BB). Also supports slot==-1 (position-only placement, rect from buf+0x28 frame id).

Slot-record geometry (bag class): 46 records (0x2E), stride 0xC2C, base bag+0x774; flag at slot base, width/height at +0x778/+0x77C, 0xC20 (0x308 dword) item record at +0x780. Index math confirmed in 0x42FCC0 (slot -> bag + (779*slot)*4 = bag + 3116*slot; flag probe [bag+3116*slot+0x774], record base +0x780, rep movsd 0x308 to dest, then 0x42FB20 notify, returns 1/0) and in 0x42F675-0x42F687. NOTE vs trade: the trade window's own slot records sit at trade+0x5B8 (24 x 0xC2C, 2 blocks x 12) - different class, same 0xC2C stride.

All 10 handler call sites named (xrefs total=13; dispatch verified from raw table dumps): msg 0x35 (case 0x41F0F0) -> 0x41F20C; msg 0xC8 (case 0x41EE34) -> 0x41EE9F (also parses item name 0x42E2D0, compares string table 0x47ADC4-0x47ADEC, formats 0x47B9BC -> chat 0x415280 - 'item obtained' display); msg 0x259 (case 0x41F40E, dispatch `sub eax,0x258; je 0x41F51F; dec eax; je 0x41F40E`) -> 0x41F4DC (record from [ebx+0x2A54C4]); msg 0x268 (case 0x41F604, dispatch 0x41F590 `add eax,-0x264` -> table 0x421E8C[4]=0x41F604) -> 0x41F63F (record from [ebx+0x2D79F0], guarded by [ebx+0x2D79F0]!=0); msg 0x27C (case 0x41FD36, dispatch 0x41F8C6 `lea edi,[eax-0x26E]` -> byte 0x421F2C[0xE]=4 -> case 0x421EB0[4]=0x41FD36) -> 0x41FDE2 (pushes flag 1 + word [ebx+0x2A54C6]); msg 0x2A2 (case 0x42045B, table 0x422080[3]=0x42045B) -> 0x4205B8 (record [ebx+0x2A54C4]) AND 0x420605 (record [ebx+0x2EB84C], gated by [ebx+0x2EB848]; weight [ebx+0x35B1E8] += [ebx+0x2EB840] between the fills); msg 0x2A4 (case 0x420671, byte 0x422080[5]) -> 0x4206AC (record from parse buffer); msg 0x2A5 (case 0x4206CE, byte 0x422080[6]) -> 0x42074F (record from ebp loop); msg 0x2A9 (case 0x4204FD, byte 0x422080[7]) -> 0x42052D (bag-list loop: counter [esp+0x20] records, ebp stride 0xC2C, [ebp-0xC]!=0 gate; then string-compare 0x47ADB4 vs [ebx+0x2A54C8] and conditional second fill from [ebx+0x2A54C4]). Msgs 0x35/0xC8 verified via table 0x421D8C idx=msg-6 (0x2F->9->case 0x421D5C[9]=0x41F0F0; 0xC2->10->0x41EE34).

Every one of the 10 handler fills targets the PLAYER BAG object: each site executes `lea ecx,[ebx+0x2AB9E0]` immediately before `call 0x42FC20` (observed at 0x41EE99/0x41F206/0x41F4D6/0x41F639/0x41FDDC/0x420527/0x4205B2/0x4205FF/0x4206A6/0x420749). No 0x42FC20 caller uses the trade object (game+0x2D8E28) or any other bag. The 0x2AB9E0 bag is the same object the bag window (0x42EA80, window.inventory) draws.

The 3 non-handler direct callers: (a) 0x42E0C1 - login/reset dump loop (0x42E09B: ebx=0x2E records, ebp stride 0xC2C, [ebp-0xC]!=0 gate, pushes 0/0, fills the bag at [esp+0x18]+0x6554 - a SECOND bag object, [INFERENCE] the login item list; which inventory it is stays open); (b) 0x42FD97 inside bag-class method 0x42FD30 (re-place an existing slot: 0x430920 init, 0x42FCC0 reads the slot record, flag 1 + slot, record copied from [ebx+0x18], ret 0xC); (c) 0x42FF6E inside 0x42FF30 (bag slot update, ret 8: if [rec]!=0 parse [rec+0x18] via 0x42E2D0 (table 0x7243A4), flag 1 + slot arg, copy [rec+0x18] record, call 0x42FC20, then zero 0x30E dwords at rec and set word [rec+0x1A]). 0x42FF30 has exactly 2 callers: 0x4303A8 and 0x4303DC (bag-class region).

Msg 0x2A3 (case 0x420640, table 0x422080[4]) is NOT a bag fill: it parses the record at [ebx+0x2EB84C] via 0x42E2D0, calls 0x416E20 (trade pending flush: 0x416E20 -> 0x4161F0 trade item drop) with this=lea [ebx+0x2D8E28], then zeroes 0x30E dwords at [ebx+0x2A54AC]. No 0x42FC20 call. Msg 0x29E (case 0x4203F7) shows the trade-gold amount dialog 0x418030 (format 0x47B70C, base 0x565994, tag 0xFFFF) then resets the bag's +0x2375C stats block via 0x42FF90 (zeroes +0x2375C/+0x23760/+0x23770, sets +0x23764/+0x23768=-1) on ecx=[ebx+0x2AB9E0].

The trade window +0x298 item-id words are written by a SEPARATE chain, never by 0x42FC20: inbound msgs 0x2A6 (case 0x420766) and 0x2AA (case 0x42081D) parse item records and call 0x4161F0 ('trade item drop', this=[ebx+0x2D8E28], 0x2AA pushes flag 1) -> 0x416269 -> 0x416490 (cell-place: `mov word ptr [ecx],bx` loop at 0x4164E4 writes item-id WORD at [trade+0x298+2*cell]; also slot+0x3E8 marker at 0x4164F9); msg 0x2A3 -> 0x416E20 flush -> 0x4161F0 reaches the same path; initialization to 0xFFFF is the ctor/reset `mov ecx,0xC8; or eax,-1; lea edi,[esi+0x298]; rep stosd` at 0x4158B3 (trade pre-ctor 0x415650, vtable 0x476624). Trade slot records at trade+0x5B8: 24 x 0xC2C in 2 blocks x 12 (0x416150 loops `cmp ebp,0xC; jl` with add edi,0xC2C; record layout: dword flag @+0, item name string @+0x10, item id @+0x49).

Outbound trade senders are outbound-only and never write +0x298: 0x451AA0 sends msg 0x402, 0x451AD0 sends msg 0x403 (both arg = item, 0x452940 header build + 0x451E60 wire send + 0x451E60 ret path), 0x451B00 sends msg 0x405 (gold amount arg, header dword0), 0x451B30 sends msg 0x406 (accept, header-only - per EI-295), and 0x451B60 sends msg 0x400. Their IDs (0x400-0x406) are below the inbound dispatch range (0x29F+), confirming they are not inbound handlers. Pairing each outbound request with its inbound reply (candidates: 0x2A6/0x2AA trade item place for 0x402/0x403; 0x2A4/0x2A5 bag fills; 0x2AB trade request+chat; 0x29E gold dialog) requires runtime packet traces and stays pending.

CORRECTION of the closed pending text: the grid cell-table origin observed at 0x42F440 is [bag + 0x324 + 12*row + 2*col] (from 0x42F470 `lea edi,[esi+esi*2+0xb1]; shl edi,1` and 0x42F485 `lea edx,[edx+ebp*2]` -> byte offset 2*(6*row+0x162+col)), NOT 'this+0x2C4'; the 6-WORD-per-row pitch and the value=slot+0x3E8 first-cell marker are CONFIRMED (also in path 2 at 0x42F5E5/0x42F642). The 46-slot flag array is at bag+0x774 (not +0x5B8 - that offset belongs to the trade class). Msg 0x2A3 is not a fill (see above).
